summary: New files are documented accurately and without roadmap/process narrative, but the PR leaves the upstream SchurWeyl.lean documentation asserting that exactly what this PR proves is unavailable, and the reworked AsAlgebraHom.lean header calls a monoid-algebra result a group-algebra one.
